title: Unit – 3 : Session – 6 : SLO – 1 | Connecting to MySQL with JDBC
sections: T/F: You must include the MySQL JDBC driver JAR in the classpath. — TRUE
MCQ: Class used to create a connection → C) DriverManager
Fill: Class.forName("com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver") loads the MySQL driver explicitly.
Find the output (server running, credentials correct) → A) Connection successful
MCQ: Must be specified in a JDBC URL → B) Database name
Fill: A non-default port must be specified in the JDBC URL.
Identify the error: URL without database → B) Missing database name
Fill: getConnection() requires three arguments: URL, USERNAME (user), and password.
